en: Among them, R0.69P–R0.71P reaches the positive-entry temporal-packing boundary, while R0.71Q–U gives the boundaries for conditional incidence, genuine internal-entry, second-time-jet, and finite recurrence. R0.71V–W separates the fixed zero-level trace and rules out a data-uniform complete first-row ledger. R0.71X, within a fixed-dimensional small-coupling family, reaches the one-third endpoint; R0.71Y treats selected roots; R0.71Z gives the all-root slope-mass bound and launch-inclusive floor cancellation. R0.72A localizes the strong-coupling loss to the actual observation layer, R0.72B retains exact target-row participation, and R0.72C obtains phase-uniform exact-launch \(M^{-8/3}\) and fixed-positive tail \(M^{-3}\) as the sharp algebraic scales. R0.72D, on a shifted Rudin–Shapiro family, constructs a positive-time exact root, retains the full rotational charge, and obtains a normalized complete-root ledger that does not vanish but does not diverge. R0.72E returns to a fixed-carrier Bessel family and uses quantitative negative-Sobolev action to prove that the complete-root ledger, relative to the candidate \(D^{1/3}\Lambda_1\) payment, diverges like \(R^{4/3}\). R0.72F then uses regularly varying initial-layer weights to separate the selected-root \(1/3\) threshold from the Leray payment \(1/2\) threshold and identifies the minimal critical-log boundary. R0.72G, on an exact real one-carrier lattice, uses a phase gauge, the target-row identity, and Rolle–BV reduction to prove that the complete root mass is exactly of logarithmic order, yielding critical-log complete-root sharp saturation. R0.72H proves for the mixed row a carrier-count-independent moment-resolved payment; the all-odd Rudin–Shapiro family rules out the action-only version and makes the carrier power encoded by that moment attain the same order. R0.72I proves that the separated positive \(B_AQ_*\) term cannot be absorbed physically term by term, while joint exposure and odd-carrier parity prove uniform decay of the genuine complete ledger. R0.72J completes the bipartite classification of the gcd-reduced Cayley graph, distinguishes an odd cycle from a triangle return, and proves that a common-band coherent mixed-parity cubic still decays after physical normalization. R0.72K, through a root-by-root gap norming direction, closes the complete complex-target ledger and proves that its common-band physical normalization ratio still decays uniformly. R0.72L retains the actual enstrophy contrast and critical-log action and closes, as \(R\) grows, a moderate strong-coupling window; the upper edge of the window gives only \(O(1)\), while only the little-o subwindow decays. R0.72M determines the scalar action danger window exactly and, on the complete one-carrier zero-diffusion chain, proves the Bessel action-poor benchmark and sharp logarithmic cubic law. R0.72N rules out the declared launch action-poor route on the complete dissipative chain and, from Coble–He time-dependent shear decay, derives the site's corollary \(\mathcal C_{\rm diss}\lesssim a^2\sqrt\sigma\). R0.72O reinserts this cubic into the physical ledger, obtaining an \(\varepsilon^{11/6}\) numerator and an \(R^{4/3}L_{R,\varepsilon}^2\) window; the multicarrier statement is conditional on a full-superposition ED hypothesis with a uniform constant. R0.72P closes the complete propagation gate on the fixed real-collinear static-phase 1:2 positive class, and R0.72Q then, for fixed-\(M\), arbitrary-static-phase, and \(Q_2\le1/2\), proves the two-critical-point shape gate together with an exact 1:2 caustic. R0.72R constructs a four-real-dimensional rational polydisc lying entirely outside the old weighted cone, for every \(y\ge0\) closes full-heat-path root localization, and, for \(0\le y\le1\), closes the physical \((\pi/48,144,240)\) shape contract and coefficient-uniform fixed-pattern commensurate 1:2:3 triangular affine-row enhanced dissipation; the complete four-dimensional caustic stratification is unfinished. R0.72S further takes the fixed-first-harmonic \(1{:}2{:}3\) marked incidence preimages and classifies them exactly as \(A_2,A_3,A_4,A_5\), uses determinant \(5400\) to prove, modulo constants, the restricted miniversal property, and, for the pure-second \(A_2\) and real-even \(A_3\) heat paths, gives \(4/3/2\) and \(4/2/2\) as the distinct count; the latter is transverse only within the real-even slice. This does not complete the global caustic image or prove general three-dimensional Navier--Stokes regularity. R0.72T--W fixes and closes the exact scalar A2 collision block, and R0.72X then, on a fixed physical compact set, obtains the all-start A2 path; Bloch-uniformity still belongs only to that scalar path. R0.72Y starts from Navier--Stokes and rederives the complete Fourier--Leray row, pressure factor two, Orr--Sommerfeld--Squire triangularization, and velocity recovery, then separates, by spatial norm, the scalar invariant row's forcing conclusion: standard H^-1 spacetime transfer is alpha, semiclassical H^-1 spacetime transfer is alpha^2, and the standard endpoint has no vanishing alpha gain. The exact zero-coupling lift-up shows that epsilon-only full-row closure and every-row strict contraction are FALSE. R0.72Z, on the high-gap \(q\)-graph, closes signed OS pressure and orientation-paid Squire history; R0.73A uses the hidden physical mean to close a low-gap \(X_\mu\) finite transient; R0.73B then uses exact Bloch carrier cancellation to close the complete linear velocity/Squire rows' viscous-rate physical-kinetic direct sum. Thus the low-gap vector direct sum at viscous rates is CLOSED; the complete OS--Squire A2 direct sum, sharp \(|\Lambda|\) law, nonlinear Navier--Stokes, and Clay remain OPEN. R0.73C then uses the exact cubic neutral spectrum and a validated periodic-ODE monodromy sign certificate to prove an infinite-dimensional frozen Rayleigh instability; viscous fast-time transfer remains OPEN, and super-polynomial complete-row no-go is only CONDITIONAL. R0.73D then, in the exact kinetic space, proves static vanishing-viscosity persistence of the certified inviscid spectral cluster, operator-norm convergence of the Riesz projections, and preservation of algebraic multiplicity; the general precedent belongs to Shvydkoy--Friedlander, while the complement and fast-time transfer remain OPEN. R0.73E uses fixed-positive-half-plane completeness, a relative dichotomy for the complete top cluster, and a fixed-generator Volterra argument to close logarithmic fast-time transfer; the moving-profile fixed-window problem, complete OS--Squire, nonlinearity, and Clay remain OPEN.

en: Research Note R0.73E: fixed-positive-half-plane spectral completeness, a relative dichotomy for the complete top cluster, and logarithmic fast-time transfer; the moving spectral bundle, nonlinearity, and Clay remain open.

zh: 一般谱持续、半群判据和非自治理论只作为边界
en: General spectral persistence, semigroup criteria, and nonautonomous theory serve only as boundaries

zh: 一条线性 Fourier 行上的多项式上界障碍已从条件命题升级为定理
en: The obstruction to polynomial upper bounds on one linear Fourier row has been upgraded from a conditional proposition to a theorem

zh: 有限矩阵解释为什么不能只删一个领先谱簇
en: Finite matrices explain why removing only one leading spectral cluster is insufficient

zh: 有限实验与监控
en: Finite experiments and monitoring

zh: 右侧全部谱簇必须一起投影
en: All spectral clusters on the right must be projected together

zh: 在不同几何和范数中给出统一半群先例。
en: provides a precedent for uniform semigroup bounds in a different geometry and norm.

zh: 这比只追踪 R0.73C 的一个 \(\sigma_*\) 更强，也更必要。有限诊断显示，移除领先有限谱簇后仍有正实部共轭对；这项有限观察不被解释为 continuum 点谱证明。
en: This is stronger and more necessary than tracking only one \(\sigma_*\) from R0.73C. The finite diagnostic shows a conjugate pair with positive real part after the leading finite spectral cluster is removed; this finite observation is not interpreted as a proof of continuum point spectrum.

zh: 证明把紧矩形上的 compact--Fredholm 收敛与高虚部 \(O(|\operatorname{Im}z|^{-1})\) resolvent 尾部拼接。结论对每个固定 \(b>0\) 成立，不对 \(b\downarrow0\) 一致。
en: The proof joins compact--Fredholm convergence on a compact rectangle to a high-imaginary-part resolvent tail of order \(O(|\operatorname{Im}z|^{-1})\). The conclusion holds for every fixed \(b>0\), but is not uniform as \(b\downarrow0\).

zh: R0.73E 把局部谱簇持续、完整正半平面控制、相对二分和缓慢漂移连接成闭合证明链。它对识别高频线性增长机制有实质价值，但对 Clay 问题的直接价值仍有限：没有非线性频率耦合、能量闭合、延拓准则或奇性构造。
en: R0.73E connects local spectral-cluster persistence, complete positive-half-plane control, a relative dichotomy, and slow drift into a closed proof chain. It has substantive value for identifying a high-frequency linear-growth mechanism, but its direct value for the Clay problem remains limited: it contains no nonlinear frequency coupling, energy closure, continuation criterion, or singularity construction.

zh: 目标是建立统一谱隙与演化二分，把 logarithmic fast-time lower bound 升级为 fixed-window \(e^{c|\Lambda|}\)。graph-domain/Kato transport 仍只是候选方法。

zh: 四十个阶段、121 个节点：从约化递推和环带排除到一条精确线性行的对数快时间传递。
en: Forty phases and 121 nodes: from reduced recurrences and annular exclusions to logarithmic fast-time transfer on one exact linear row.

zh: 选取完整 top cluster 后，Bromwich 移线给出相对 semigroup dichotomy；精确 \(O(\varepsilon\theta)\) profile drift 再通过固定生成元 Volterra 论证传递到任意固定 \(M\log(1/\varepsilon)\) 快时间。
en: After selecting the complete top cluster, a Bromwich contour shift gives a relative semigroup dichotomy; the exact \(O(\varepsilon\theta)\) profile drift then transfers through a fixed-generator Volterra argument to any fixed fast-time scale \(M\log(1/\varepsilon)\).

zh: 一条精确线性行的对数快时间增长已成为定理；固定窗口与非线性仍未闭合
en: Logarithmic fast-time growth on one exact linear row is now a theorem; the fixed window and nonlinearity remain unclosed

zh: 这页保留 R0.61 到 R0.73E 的全部 121 个节点。R0.61–R0.69W 从约化递推走到严格环带排除；R0.70A–R0.71Z 检查移动尺度、临界账本、内部 entry 与 complete-root 边界；R0.72A–R0.73B 处理 strong coupling、critical log、碰撞几何与完整线性 Fourier--Leray 行；R0.73C 认证冻结 Rayleigh 不稳定，R0.73D 闭合静态黏性谱簇持续，R0.73E 再闭合固定正半平面与对数快时间传递。一般三维 nonlinear 与 Clay 没有被外推。
en: This page retains, from R0.61 through R0.73E, all 121 nodes. R0.61–R0.69W moves from reduced recurrences to rigorous annular exclusion; R0.70A–R0.71Z examines moving scales, critical ledgers, internal entry, and complete-root boundaries; R0.72A–R0.73B treats strong coupling, the critical log, collision geometry, and the complete linear Fourier--Leray row; R0.73C certifies frozen Rayleigh instability, R0.73D closes static viscous spectral-cluster persistence, and R0.73E closes the fixed positive half-plane and logarithmic fast-time transfer. No extrapolation is made to general three-dimensional nonlinearity or Clay.
